misconceptions.description: Doesn't carry: writes only each column's ones digit (47 + 38 -> 75).
Writes each column's whole sum side by side (47 + 38 -> 715).
Subtracts the smaller digit from the larger in each column (52 - 27 -> 35).
Borrows but doesn't take 1 from the next column (503 - 278 -> 335).
Gives a neighbouring fact, one group off (7 x 8 -> 48 or 64).
Leaves a remainder bigger than the divisor (47 / 5 -> 8 R 7).
Gives the quotient and drops the remainder (47 / 5 -> 9).
Lists multiples instead of factors (factors of 6 -> 6, 12, 18).
Lists only some of the factors, usually missing a pair (factors of 24 without 4 and 6).
Stops before every factor is prime (60 = 4 x 15).
Gives the least common multiple when asked for the greatest common factor.
Gives a common factor that isn't the greatest (24 and 36 -> 6 instead of 12).
Gives the greatest common factor when asked for the least common multiple.
Multiplies the two numbers instead of finding the least common multiple (6 and 8 -> 48).
